known_limits: Final scores are exposed regression retests, not a fresh independent holdout result.
No production traffic, human relevance labels, nDCG, precision, satisfaction or broad quality uplift is claimed.
Confluence c04 is retrieved with similarity0.2222222222 but removed by the existing0.4 service threshold.
Google Maps c03/c10 direct results include a record that mentions the product without establishing full route-planning task fit.
Public p03 metadata includes both RedNote note access and a hot-news aggregator; aggregate/offline task-fit contract remains failed.
Public p13/p14 conjunction requirements and exclusions are outside this slice; existing behavior is retained.
Offline-only still misses some valid metadata-bearing records.
Five ordinary query parity probes and finite syntax diagnostics do not establish all paraphrase behavior.

This evaluator did not run raw MCP stdio replay, other online providers, optional professional service networking, packaged CLI/native sharp startup or Inspector UI. Professional ranking and failure handling were checked with a controlled ranker.
Root and implementation worker report repository-wide tests/CI separately.
